title: Growth bound from an approximate tangent plane (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(3))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let D ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set, x ∈ ℝ^P, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P, and r₀ > 0 with H^n(D ∩ B̄_{r₀}(x)) < ∞, where H^n := μHE[n]. Suppose D has approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n D x Q). That is, finrank Q = n and, for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ), ∫_{η_{x,r}(D)} f dH^n → ∫_Q f dH^n as r → 0 in 𝓝[>] 0. Then there are real numbers C and r₁ with r₁ > 0 such that H^n(D ∩ B̄_ρ(x)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(C · ρ^n) for all ρ ∈ (0, r₁).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (r₀ : ℝ), MeasurableSet D → 0 < r₀ → μHE[n] (D ∩ closedBall x r₀) ≠ ∞ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n D x Q → ∃ C r₁ : ℝ, 0 < r₁ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < r₁ → μHE[n] (D ∩ closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)
